plugin.name: Message Enhancer
plugin.description: Turn a short scene description into a full enhanced message draft (User tab), or guide a reroll of the character's last reply (Char tab), with a custom OOC prompt and Try Again support.
settings.info: Configure the default behavior of Enhance Message. A custom OOC prompt can still be added per-use in the panel.
settings.showFab.label: Show floating button (FAB)
settings.showEnhancerFab.label: Show Message Enhancer floating button
settings.defaultOoc.label: Default OOC instruction
settings.length.label: Target length
settings.presetId.label: Preset ID override (optional, leave blank to use current chat preset)
